source.title: The geometric calculus of variations: A short survey and a list of open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/4052405 with source name 4052405. The zbMATH REST API identified record 4052405 / Zbl 0645.49001 as Jürgen Jost, "The geometric calculus of variations: A short survey and a list of open problems," Expositiones Mathematicae 6, no. 2, pages 111-143, 1988. This metadata was used only for identity and recovery, not as extraction evidence.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged / metadata_only. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/4052405 returned a Cloudflare challenge HTTP 403, while the zbMATH API record exposed bibliographic metadata but no readable technical full text and no full-text links.

Identifier-specific recovery found no DOI or readable artifact for the exact work. Crossref exact-title/year recovery did not return the Jost article. OpenAlex title recovery returned unrelated works and no exact match. ScienceDirect journal and issue access was blocked or unavailable in the local fetch path.

Exact-title web recovery inspected available candidates and rejected them because they were not readable primary sources for the same work: nLab pages and a German dissertation only cited the article, the zbMATH serial page was journal metadata, and the NoZDR result was an unauthoritative third-party file listing rather than a source-authorized readable copy.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. No questions were extracted because the available sources were resolver metadata, snippets, citations, blocked landing pages, or unauthoritative file listings.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/4052405.json and outputs/latest.json.
